# UiBreadcrumbs

Shows the path to the current page as links.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | navigation |
| Import | `import { UiBreadcrumbs } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiBreadcrumbs from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiBreadcrumbs'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/navigation/UiBreadcrumbs.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/navigation/UiBreadcrumbs.vue) |
| Generic | `T extends UiBreadcrumbItem` |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` **(required)** | `readonly TItem[]` |  | Trail from the root to the current page. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the navigation landmark. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `props: { item: T; current: boolean }` | Content of one crumb (the label by default). |

## Attributes

The `<nav>` element.

## Keyboard

- Links are ordinary tab stops.

## Accessibility

- A labelled `<nav>` with an ordered list of links: navigation, not a menu.
- The last item is `aria-current="page"` and is not a link.
- Separators are decorative and mirror in right-to-left text.

## Styling

- `.vui-breadcrumbs`, `.vui-breadcrumbs__link`, `.vui-breadcrumbs__separator`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/NavigationDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/NavigationDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<UiBreadcrumbs :items="crumbs" />
```
